name: Rich Per the Pedlar
description: A wealthy travelling trader who becomes obsessed with preventing a prophecy and grows increasingly ruthless, only to be trapped by his own schemes.
visualPrompt: A prosperous middle-aged pedlar in sturdy travelling clothes and boots, with a sharp, calculating expression, a money pouch at his belt, and a well-worn pack of goods; looks proud and controlling, set in a rural Nordic landscape.

name: The Miller’s Lad
description: The prophesied bridegroom: abandoned as a baby, raised by millers, and grown into a courageous, resourceful young man who survives plots and completes a dragon-quest.
visualPrompt: A young man with an open, determined face and simple mill-worker clothing, carrying a stout bundle for travel; later bearing three dark feathers and a broad sword, looking brave and steady.

name: Per’s Daughter
description: Rich Per’s sheltered daughter whose forced fate becomes a genuine partnership after the forged letter brings an unexpected wedding.
visualPrompt: A young woman in modest but fine countryside dress, calm and resilient, with practical hands and an attentive gaze; hints of new independence rather than courtly glamour.

name: The Dragon of Deep-Ford
description: A fearsome dragon dwelling in a riverside castle, keeper of treasure and secret answers, defeated by a single decisive stroke.
visualPrompt: A massive, menacing dragon with heavy scales and a powerful tail tipped with distinct long feathers, eyes like embers, lounging within a shadowed stone hall overflowing with treasure; terrifying, ancient presence.

name: The Princess in the Dragon’s Castle
description: A captive princess who aids the lad with strength-giving drink and strategy, turning a hopeless mission into victory and freedom.
visualPrompt: A pale, resolute princess in a worn but noble gown, holding a small bottle and standing near a wall-hung sword in a dim castle chamber; expression alert and courageous, burdened yet defiant.
